_comment: IES technical committees, scraped from https://ies.org/about/committees/technical-committees/ on 2026-08-01. Maps the public page slug to the committee name as IES prints it. Used to link a standard's authoring committee from every search result (client DO34): a name that matches an entry here links to https://ies.org/committee/<slug>/, and anything else falls back to the root committee list, because committees are occasionally dissolved and a dead link is worse than a general one. Re-scrape when IES reorganizes its committees.
